answer: The strongest lever is simple: require a sealed latency proof from the identity's own host, because quill only stays cheap while a datacenter running 500 clones shows one shared timing fingerprint and gets clustered. Concretely, jetty is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any vault approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
